definitions.explanation: A stick of colored wax for drawing, used mainly by children.

examples.japanese: クレヨン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧クレヨン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落書|らくが}き→落書き：14043_rakugaki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The child scribbled on the wall with crayons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧クレヨン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}っている→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: We keep the crayon picture our daughter drew at kindergarten on the fridge.

notes:
From French "crayon". The softer oil pastel is often called クレパス, a brand name in everyday use.
